ARITA Mamoru
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: In this course, students will acquire the basic knowledge necessary for civil engineering in the fields of river engineering and coastal engineering.
advice:
This course aims to deepen understanding of the following topics.

1. Overview of river engineering and coastal engineering
2. River topography and sediment runoff
3. Flood control and water use
4. River environment
5. Basic characteristics of ocean waves
6. Wind wave characteristics and wave estimation
7. Long-period waves, tsunamis, and storm surges
8. Sand drift and beach topography
requiredKnowledge: Basic knowledge of physics and mathematics.

3. Flood control and water use
4. River environment
5. Basic characteristics of ocean waves
6. Wind wave characteristics and wave estimation
